## Scope

- [ ] Documentation/package only; script source remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
- [ ] English documentation and internal links have been reviewed.
- [ ] No genuine backup, host logs, secrets or private network details added.
- [ ] Any platform/test claims identify their actual evidence class.

## Change and rationale

Describe the documentation issue and cited source behavior. Source changes are outside the current freeze and require separate owner approval.
